findings.source_quote: The Dayspring shineth from on high,
findings.suggested_fix: Translate “Dayspring” as dawn or daybreak, for example: “De dageraad breekt aan van omhoog,” rather than “Morgenster,” which means “morning star.”
findings.translation_quote: De Morgenster schijnt van hoogten neer,

findings.source_quote: In wondrous beauty bend the knee;
findings.suggested_fix: Use idiomatic Dutch, such as “Buig in wonderlijke schoonheid de knie;”
findings.translation_quote: In wonderlijke schoonheid buig het knieval;
